design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 of parking_rate_increase_and_compliance (round 4).

STEP 0 — draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 4]}. Assignment: vehicle swap fee 6 factors, tow notice fee 4, tow redemption payment 4. Scope snapshot: task 0 occupies the billing-error correction, late fee assessment, bring-current payment (delinquent, any amount) and retention concession with their four tools; this task claims parking_ext_tow_notice_fee, parking_ext_tow_redemption_payment, parking_ext_vehicle_swap_fee and their three tools, completing coverage of the seven extended policies. The redemption payment differs from task 0's payment in kind: base allows any amount while delinquent but only a full redemption after a tow notice, and only the redemption returns the agreement to active.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Desmond Ingram asks only to switch the vehicle on file for space P-237 to his new pickup. The swap rule states that a different vehicle is not put on file until the agreement stands in active status; the agreement is tow_noticed (notice of intent to tow 2025-10-24, cycle from 2025-09-08). Only the redemption payment, the tenant's own act, returns it to active, and the redemption amount is fixed only after a tow notice fee stands on the ledger for the cycle — the ledger has none. The agent must discover the chain, post the missing fee, hand over a redemption of the right amount, then compute the swap fee from six ladders.

PROBLEM TREE CARD. Root parking_ext_vehicle_swap_fee (agent). Edge 1: swap -> redemption, state_gate on parking_rentals.status, state form, 'A different vehicle is not put on file until the agreement stands in active status.' (negated); opening status tow_noticed; only the redemption write sets active. Edge 2: redemption -> tow notice fee, value_input on pt_balance, state form, 'The redemption amount after a notice of intent to tow is fixed only after a tow notice fee stands on the ledger for the delinquency cycle the notice was sent for.' (affirmative); opening ledger has no tow_notice_fee; only the tow-notice-fee policy books one. Order: tow notice fee -> redemption (owner=user, credit card) -> swap; a chain, unique. Deletion sensitivity: skip fee -> redemption 395.00 (vs 452.75); skip redemption -> status stays tow_noticed, no payment row. Four-point test passed for both sentences (connectives not until / only after; record-visible states; no tool, id or code token; hard requirement scoped to the cycle / status).

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Tow notice fee (parking_fee_charge): late_fee_and_waiver grace_expired (2025-09-08 + 5 grace days, exclusive -> from 2025-09-14) and fee_status (tow_noticed allowed). Redemption (parking_payment): tow_process full_payment_after_tow_notice is retired by a declared overwrite: base 'after the tow notice only a payment of the full balance is accepted, and it returns the agreement to active and restores the gate code.' is replaced by the extended scope sentence (only the full redemption amount — balance plus next-period share, deposit, dispatch hold and AutoPay advance — is accepted, and it returns the agreement to active); a payment of the bare balance does not redeem under the extended charter. Portfolio review policy scope. Swap (parking_vehicle_update): vehicle_fit swap_status (active after the redemption); vehicle_fits and compliance renewal_stated are restated by declared overwrites as the tenant reading type, length, plate and expiry dates from the documents (the base gates bind the agreement number to a caller statement, which no caller can state — base-layer defect routed around); space_features policy scope. Fit: pickup 19 ft <= 20 ft class maximum, car_or_pickup allowed. Swap allowance: one swap (2025-03-02) in the 365-day window, below 2.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Fee: the tow notice of the cycle anchored 2025-09-08, referenced to the oldest unpaid rent charge 2025-09-08; the 2024-01-12 notice belongs to an earlier, cured cycle and is excluded. Redemption: agreement P-237 balance. Swap: vehicle fields of P-237; the sedan BZ22K41 is replaced by PKT2268.

FACTOR CARD (sim_t1.py). Tow notice fee 57.75 = 55.00 x 1.25 - 6.00 - 5.00; baseline (class fee 40.00) 40.00; factor baselines: level 39.00, multiplier 44.00, tenure relief 63.75, AutoPay relief 62.75 (cross-difficulty: autopay suspended, expired-card declines). Redemption 452.75 = 287.75 + 95.00 + 20.00 + 35.00 + 15.00; baseline (balance) 287.75; factor baselines: next period 357.75, deposit 432.75, dispatch hold 417.75, AutoPay advance 437.75 (cross-difficulty). Swap fee 25.25 = 25.00 x 0.75 x 0.6 + 10.00 + 8.00 - 4.00; baseline (class fee 15.00) 15.00; factor baselines: level 20.75, tenure 29.00, period 32.75, re-verification 15.25, document check 17.25, good record 29.25. Multi-source: tenure relief and good-record reduction (tenure AND payments). Near-misses: the 2024-01-12 tow notice counts for the level but is outside the current cycle for the dispatch hold; the August 2025 draft declined but the tenant paid within grace, so no August late fee.

OVERWRITES. Tow notice fee: only the clause 'posts tow_notice_fee_usd' is replaced by the fee order sentence (delivery by certified mail and email and the move to tow_noticed stay in force). Redemption: 'after the tow notice only a payment of the full balance is accepted, and it returns the agreement to active and restores the gate code.' replaced by the redemption scope sentence. Swap: the vehicle-fit sentence; only the clause 'A renewed registration or insurance is recorded when the tenant states the new expiry date exactly as printed on the document' (the cure-returns-to-active clause stays); the clause 'and each swap posts vehicle_swap_fee_usd.'; and the clause 'A different vehicle may be put on file only on an agreement in active status' (replaced by the swap's own prerequisite sentence). The rolling 365-day swap allowance stays in force from base, and the extended scope sentence restates it.

SEED. 13 rent charges (2024-10-08..2025-10-08), 11 payments, the March 2025 swap fee, late fees for September and October, gate lockout, two tow notices, the suspended AutoPay authorization with 13 drafts. Automatic clauses: the tow itself is allowed only from 2025-11-08, after frozen_time; November rent is due 2025-11-08, also later.

PERSONA. Rushed field electrician back from a contract; volunteers only the vehicle switch; identity, space, truck details, AutoPay card story only on request; alarmed but cooperative when told of a notice or fee; pays exactly the quoted amount with his new credit card when handed the payment; closes when told the pickup is on file.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate (phone), verify (phone + ZIP), read agreement, ledger, notices, AutoPay enrollment and drafts; post the tow notice fee 57.75; hand over the redemption of 452.75 by credit card; put the pickup on file with swap fee 25.25.

VERIFICATION. sim_t1.py replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each compute through check_compute's evaluator on its handling-time world; outputs equal computations and gold. A draft recomputation from the rules, docstrings and records alone reaches the same chain and figures.

ROUND 2 REVISIONS (policy-task audit). T1-1/F2: symptom two redemption amounts (287.75 vs 452.75); root cause undeclared override of the base full-balance sentence; change: declared overwrite on parking_ext_tow_redemption_payment; re-run 452.75 unchanged. T1-2/F4: the dispatch hold's tiers no longer restate the redemption scope; they turn only on how far away the earliest tow date is (4 days -> near-tow hold); 452.75 unchanged. F3: the swap level ladder is now the class fee plus a repeat or returning step, so no two tiers coincide on any class; this class still gives 25.00. T1-3: the swap overwrite now supersedes only the fee clause, so the base swap allowance and active-status requirement remain in force, and the extended scope sentence states the allowance (the yaml rebuild that carries it was missing in round 1). Gates re-run green.

ROUND 4 REVISION (KB-audit policy-side note). Base 'A different vehicle may be put on file only on an agreement in active status' stated the same gate as the swap's prerequisite sentence; it is now declared superseded by that sentence, so the dependency is stated once, in the swap policy's own rule (the base swap allowance in the rest of that base sentence stays in force and is restated in the swap scope sentence). No scored value moved: 57.75 / 452.75 / 25.25.
user_scenario:
You are Desmond Ingram, a field electrician from Tempe who has spent the late summer and fall on a contract job in North Dakota and got home two days ago. You keep a car in an uncovered space at the Bluegate facility in Tempe, and while you were away you bought a new pickup truck and sold your old sedan; the buyer is collecting the sedan from the space this weekend. You are calling Bluegate's care line on a weekday afternoon, a bit rushed, because you want the vehicle on file for your parking space switched to the new pickup so you can start parking it there. You want the agent to make the change for you on this call; you are not asking for anything else.

You talk fast and casually and you tend to say "yeah, yeah" while you look for things. You do not volunteer your details. When asked who you are, you give your name and your cell, 4805552391, and if they need a second detail you give the billing ZIP, 85283. If asked which space, it is space P-237, the uncovered car space at the Tempe store. Your email, if they ask, is desmond.ingram@gmail.com.

When the agent asks about the new vehicle, you read it off the registration card: it is a pickup truck, 19 feet long, plate PKT2268, and the registration expires October 31, 2026; the insurance card for the truck runs to April 30, 2026. If the agent asks about the old car, the sedan on file has plate BZ22K41 and you are letting its insurance run out at the end of its term later this month because you sold it.

You have not opened the mail that piled up while you were gone. Only if the agent asks about your payments do you say that the credit card on your AutoPay expired in July and you have a new card but never got around to updating it. If the agent tells you about a notice or a fee on the account, you are alarmed, say you had no idea, and ask the agent what you need to do. If the agent explains that you have to pay an amount on the space and tells you the figure, you say you will pay it right now with your new credit card, and once the agent hands the payment over to you, you pay exactly the amount the agent told you with your credit card and read back the confirmation. You do not argue about the figure.

When the agent confirms the pickup is now the vehicle on file for your space, you thank them, say you will be by with the truck this weekend, and end the call. If the agent says the change cannot be made today, you ask them to tell you why in one sentence and then end the call.

edges.condition: A tow notice fee entry stands on the ledger for the delinquency cycle of the standing notice of intent to tow.
edges.policy_source: The redemption amount after a notice of intent to tow is fixed only after a tow notice fee stands on the ledger for the delinquency cycle the notice was sent for.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2025-10-24 notice of intent to tow stands but no tow notice fee entry is on the ledger.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The tow notice fee of 57.75 is posted; the balance due the redemption is worked out from becomes 287.75.

edges.policy_source: A different vehicle is not put on file until the agreement stands in active status.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The agreement stands tow_noticed, not active.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The redemption payment sets the agreement's status to active and clears its delinquency date.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain: the tow notice fee precedes the redemption (its balance includes the fee: 395.00 without it vs 452.75), and the redemption precedes the swap (only an active agreement takes a different vehicle). No pair of writes is unordered.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the tow notice fee: redemption 395.00 instead of 452.75, no fee row, terminal balance differs.
Skipping the redemption: status stays tow_noticed instead of active, no payment row, balance 287.75 + swap fee instead of a credit; the swap would be recorded on a tow_noticed agreement.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to switch the vehicle on file; it never mentions a tow notice, a fee, a balance or a payment. He reacts to a notice or fee only after the agent raises it, and pays only after the agent explains an amount must be paid.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: swap_parking_vehicle_d3106476 updates the vehicle fields and creates the fee row without reading the status; pay_parking_tow_redemption_54345a56 and post_parking_tow_notice_fee_6c1b851a create one ledger row each and update the agreement; none refuses or checks a prerequisite (task_tools.py bodies).
